instruction: Disable the background cone logo in VLC's interface preferences.

files.path: /home/user/Desktop/Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully opened VLC Media > Open File dialog, navigated to Desktop, selected the Rick Astley mp4, and played it. Task completed in 7 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can interact with VLC menus, navigate file open dialog, browse directories, select and open media files, control playback
metadata.task_rationale: Tests VLC interface preferences modification - agent must find and toggle the background cone setting, a different kind of VLC interaction than media playback
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to VLC Tools > Preferences > Interface and unchecking the background cone option. Uses existing check_qt_bgcone metric which reads vlcrc config file and checks qt-bgcone=0.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (vlc_config) correctly reads ~/.config/vlc/vlcrc to extract VLC configuration state
Metric (check_qt_bgcone) correctly parses vlcrc for 'qt-bgcone=' setting and compares against expected value
Expected value '0' correctly represents 'disabled' for the background cone logo setting
Metric correctly handles the expected parameter by directly accessing rule['expected_qt_bgcone'] (no incorrect nesting)
Complete coverage: single instruction requirement (disable bg cone) is fully verified by single evaluator check
No postconfig needed - vlcrc is a persistent config file, not transient UI state
